openPalette.body: Open Ask AI with {{shortcut}} from anywhere.
openPalette.bodyMobile: Ask where something is, or tell AI what to do.
openPalette.title: Ask anything

photoToBin.body: Attach a photo and AI creates a {{bin}} from it — items, tags, notes included.
photoToBin.title: Drop a photo into the chat

tryQuery.body: Ask "where are the batteries?" or "create a kitchen utensils {{bin}}".
tryQuery.title: Try a query

voiceInput.body: Tap the mic to dictate — great for hands-busy capture.
voiceInput.title: Talk instead of type

binAppearance.body: Tags filter across {{bins}}, {{areas}} group them, and appearance themes printed labels.
binAppearance.title: Tags, area, and appearance

binQr.body: The 6-character code is a printable QR. Stick it on the {{bin}} — anyone in this {{location}} can scan or type it.
binQr.title: Every {{bin}} has a code

binTabs.body: Switch tabs for files, a usage heatmap, and activity — see when this {{bin}} was last opened and what changed.
binTabs.title: See what's happening

binToolbar.body: The toolbar has every action you need: edit contents, pin for quick access, print a label, duplicate, or move.
binToolbar.title: Edit, pin, print, duplicate

quickAdd.bodyAi: Type "3 screwdrivers, a tape measure" and tap the spark — AI parses it into items with quantities.
quickAdd.bodyNoAi: Type an item name and press Enter. Paste a comma-separated list for multiple.
quickAdd.title: Add items fast

bulkActionBar.body: Tick one or more {{bins}} and this bar floats up with every bulk action: tags, {{areas}}, appearance, checkout status, or delete.
bulkActionBar.title: The action bar unlocks bulk edits

selectToggle.body: Tap any row's checkbox to start selecting {{bins}}.
selectToggle.title: Pick {{bins}} to bulk edit

undoToast.body: Bulk deletes can be reversed from a single coalesced undo toast — no per-item confirmation needed.
undoToast.title: One toast, one undo

bulkAddConfirm.body: AI suggestions are editable. Confirm to create every {{bin}} in one go.
bulkAddConfirm.title: Create them all at once

captureCamera.body: Point your camera at a shelf, drawer, or room — AI names the {{bin}} and lists what's inside.
captureCamera.title: Snap a photo

captureGrouping.body: Toggle grouping to turn multiple photos into multiple {{bins}} in one pass.
captureGrouping.title: Group as you go

groupReview.body: Drag photos between groups, rename, or merge before the AI runs.
groupReview.title: Review before confirming

askAi.body: Ask where something is, or tell it what to do — AI can create, edit, and find {{bins}}. Try {{shortcut}}.
askAi.bodyDisabled: Use the search bar to find {{bins}} by name, tag, or contents.

cta.bodyReadonly: More tours are available from the "?" button on each page, or from Settings.
cta.bodyWrite: Create your next {{bin}} to get going. More tours are available from the "?" button on each page, or from Settings.
cta.bodyWriteAi: Try "create a {{bin}} for kitchen utensils" to get started. More tours are available from the "?" button on each page, or from Settings.
cta.title: That was the highlights

dashboardOverview.body: Your dashboard surfaces pinned {{bins}}, recent scans, checkouts, and an activity heatmap so you can see what's moving.
dashboardOverview.title: Welcome home

navSidebar.body: Open Items, Tags, or {{areas}} for cross-{{bin}} views and bulk edits — plus the trash and activity log.
navSidebar.title: Cross-bin views

scanQr.body: Point your camera at a label to jump straight to that {{bin}}, or type its 6-character code.
scanQr.title: Scan or search

bulk-edit.summary: Select, action bar, and coalesced undo
bulk-edit.title: Bulk edit

create-ai.summary: Capture, group, and review AI-generated bins
create-ai.title: Create bins from photos

highlights.summary: Dashboard, Ask AI, scan, and cross-bin views
highlights.title: Highlights

print-scan.summary: Label formats, presets, and QR scanning
print-scan.title: Print & scan

printBinSelector.body: Print labels for a handful of {{bins}} or for everything. Deep-link here from any list.
printBinSelector.title: Pick which {{bins}} to print

printMode.body: Pick a format: QR labels for scanning, name cards, or a full item checklist for inventory counts.
printMode.title: Labels, names, or item lists

printPreset.body: Turn on Customize dimensions to tweak any margin, then save your tweaks as a reusable preset — next print job is one click.
printPreset.title: Customize and save presets

scanQr.body: Point your camera at any printed label to jump to its bin — no typing needed.
scanQr.title: Scan the printed label

reorganizeMode.body: Pick bins mode to split or merge overstuffed {{bins}}; pick tags mode to consolidate tag vocabulary across {{bins}}.
reorganizeMode.title: Regroup bins or tags

reorganizeSelector.body: Pick a handful of {{bins}} or tags. The AI does better with focused input than the whole {{location}}.
reorganizeSelector.title: Focus the AI

reorganizeSubmit.body: Preview every change before committing. Nothing moves until you say go.
reorganizeSubmit.title: Preview, then apply
